episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: When the Dionisi siblings inherit the family racing team, Elena goes rogue and starts her own squad to beat her brother in the Italian Gran Turismo.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: With only days left to qualify, Elena urges Arturo to coach Blu, who must confront the shadows of her past before she can race toward her future.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Elena is cut off from the family estate and scrambles for help. The competition heats up as Blu and rival Paolo go head-to-head off the racecourse.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: A figure from Blu's past resurfaces with an unexpected request. The SC17 team runs on fumes as Elena places a risky bet that could change their future.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Elena's team suits up for a turbocharged plan to secure their finances, but Blu uncovers something from the past that could jeopardize it all.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: After an accident derails the squad, Blu faces the fallout from recent discoveries. The SC17 team must rely on faith to triumph in their final race.
